agreement.text: A PA practices under written scope of practice guidelines signed by all supervising physicians; the PA may begin ten business days after they are submitted to the board. With under two years of continuous practice, or after a specialty change, a PA needs sixty days on site before practicing off site.

agreement.text: An NP performing medical acts does so under a practice agreement with a physician readily available for consultation, reviewed, dated and signed at least annually. Changes in practice setting or physician are reported to the board within 15 business days. An NP also spends a portion of their time practicing in an underserved or rural area or serving an underserved population.
